headline: Israeli Semiconductor Firm Altair Raises $100M for Edge AI Development
summary: Hod Hasharon-based semiconductor company Altair, a Sony spin-off, raised $100 million as it makes a strategic shift toward enabling AI agents on edge devices.
why: Altair is a specialized semiconductor designer focusing on advanced connectivity and edge processing components.
